ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word

2. When practising Play: Structure and Setting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Play: Structure and Setting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Play: Structure and Setting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Play: Structure and Setting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Play: Structure and Setting.

3. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

6. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language.

8. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple Poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple Poems.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple Poems.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple Poems.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple Poems.

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. blue

10. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness.

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. going

12. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
